about.title: Meet Maytee
about.subtitle: The Lawyer of the Plants
about.bio: Maydel 'Maytee' Tuya founded Maytee's Garden Center at 15196 SW 184th St in Miami with a mission that sets her apart: rescue first, plant second. Her philosophy — that every garden deserves an advocate before a bulldozer — earned her the nickname 'the lawyer of the plants.' Maytee's expertise in South Florida's unique climate, her passion for rescuing overlooked specimens, and her eye for lush, personalized design have made her a fixture in the Miami gardening community and beyond.
